title: A landscape unfolds
alt: A continuous accordion book carries a mountain landscape across folds and raised paper trees.
description: A detailed paper object combining printed scenery, physical folds and connected pop-up elements.
prompt: A highly refined close editorial photograph of a handmade accordion-fold artist book standing half-open on a warm gray table. One continuous strip of heavy ivory paper folds into a zigzag, and a hand-painted landscape flows coherently across every fold: deep blue mountains at the left, a red bridge over a river in the center, and a small ochre village at the right. Cut-out tree silhouettes rise from the paper along the foreground while remaining attached to its base. A simple dark blue hard cover rests at each end. Realistic paper thickness, aligned fold edges, elegant shadows and watercolor texture, clear physical construction, no words or lettering.
